review_basis: Read exact frozen editorial entries; independent ChatGPT lexical-semantic assessment, not a second Muse review, not a Runtime row extraction

records.proposed_gloss_en: a device that reads images or text and converts them into digital data
records.specific_reason: Device definition fits 扫描仪/扫描器; not confused with scanning action.

records.proposed_gloss_en: in the middle of or surrounded by something
records.specific_reason: Locative/surrounding sense fits 在……之中; other figurative uses do not negate this sense.

records.proposed_gloss_en: a metric unit of volume equal to 1,000 milliliters
records.specific_reason: Volume unit and 1,000 mL conversion are exact.

records.proposed_gloss_en: a building or room equipped for exercise, physical training, or indoor sports
records.specific_reason: Exercise/training room or indoor-sport building covers the supplied facility senses.

records.proposed_gloss_en: a word used to name a person, place, thing, idea, or quality
records.specific_reason: Names a person/place/thing/idea/quality; standard grammatical noun definition.

records.proposed_gloss_en: the ability of two things to work well together or exist together without conflict
records.specific_reason: Coexistence without conflict and functional interoperability both supported.

records.proposed_gloss_en: the process of bringing separate groups or parts together to form one whole
records.specific_reason: Process of joining separate groups/parts captures 统一/合并/一体化.

records.proposed_gloss_en: television, radio, newspapers, websites, and other channels that share news or information
records.specific_reason: Current English describes news/information mass-media channels, while Chinese 媒介 can also refer to non-news transmission carriers and medium in science; either restrict Chinese to 媒体/大众传播媒介 or broaden/split explicit senses.

records.proposed_gloss_en: an early model of a product or design made to test or develop its features
records.specific_reason: Early test model of design/product captures 原型/样机 in this context.

records.proposed_gloss_en: in addition to what has already been mentioned
records.specific_reason: Supplementary discourse marker, not sequence marker, aligns 此外/另外.

records.proposed_gloss_en: an entrance or a point through which people, things, or information can pass
records.specific_reason: Entrance or passage point is valid for physical and network gateway, but distinguish the technical sense during specialized teaching.

records.proposed_gloss_en: a short test or set of questions used to check knowledge
records.specific_reason: Short knowledge-check test captures 小测验; 问答 is broader but acceptable as contextual near-synonym, not exhaustive equivalence.

records.proposed_gloss_en: things that are no longer wanted and are thrown away
records.specific_reason: Discarded unwanted materials matches 垃圾/废物.

records.proposed_gloss_en: a place where people or vehicles are stopped so that officials can check them
records.specific_reason: English limits to physical official stop/check station, while Chinese 检查点 can denote an inspection milestone or software saved state; restrict Chinese to 检查站（实体检查点） for this KU or provide explicit separate sense.

records.proposed_gloss_en: a photograph or brief record showing a particular moment
records.specific_reason: Quick photo or point-in-time record supports 快照 and software analogy.

records.proposed_gloss_en: to calculate a result using numbers or data
records.specific_reason: Calculate using numbers/data is correct mathematical/computational verb.

records.proposed_gloss_en: one of several levels or ranks in an ordered system
records.specific_reason: One level in ordered hierarchy fits 层/级.

records.proposed_gloss_en: official permission, often shown in a passport, to enter or stay in a country
records.specific_reason: Official authorization to apply for entry/stay, subject to border discretion; current language does not promise guaranteed admission.

records.proposed_gloss_en: a symbol or design used to identify a company, organization, or product
records.specific_reason: Identifying graphic symbol/design fits 标志/徽标.

records.proposed_gloss_en: to start an organization, institution, or business
records.specific_reason: Lexical verb 'establish' is correctly defined, but homograph found (past of find) has different POS/identity; verify Runtime POS and existing same-spelling KU registration before upgrading to identity-anchored overlay.

records.proposed_gloss_en: to stop, catch, or take something while it is traveling from one place to another
records.specific_reason: Stop/catch something in transit supports 拦截/截获.

records.proposed_gloss_en: the elected or appointed leader of a city or town government
records.specific_reason: City/town civic leader is correct across election/appointment jurisdictions.

records.proposed_gloss_en: a unit of length equal to 1,000 meters
records.specific_reason: Exactly 1,000 meters, and Chinese synonyms correct.

records.proposed_gloss_en: causing physical pain or emotional distress
records.specific_reason: Physical pain or emotional suffering meets source meanings.

records.proposed_gloss_en: in a formal or authorized way, or according to an official statement
records.specific_reason: Formal authorization/official-status sense valid, though not every formal act is 'official'.

records.proposed_gloss_en: able to be changed in size, position, or amount to suit a need
records.specific_reason: Capable of changing dimensions/amounts fits 可调节的.
